descriptionChirho: Qal intransitive: to put forth buds, sprout, or come into flower; used of plants, trees, rods (Aaron's rod), and vines in their literal botanical sense of producing new growth or blooms.
Qal intransitive used figuratively of persons or abstract entities: to flourish, prosper, or thrive, extending the botanical image of blossoming to human prosperity and well-being.
Hifil causative: to make something bud or flourish, indicating an agent who brings about the blossoming or prospering of another entity.
